title: ApprovedRate billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = ApprovedRate (ebilling-r1 task 070; spec FR-24, design.md 6.1). 2. The billed rate is at most the approved rate for the timekeeper or classification on the line date, plus a tolerance. Rates are reference data (rate cards), never copied here. Parameters only: no rates, timekeepers or code descriptions, and no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.

tolerancePercent.description: Percent over the approved rate still accepted, 0-100 (0 = the approved rate exactly).
